{{Quote|Our duty now, is to survive. And as our thousand-year journey ends, we will enter a finer age.|The Prince|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''The Prince''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] known to have been the leader of the [[Star Cabal]] conspiracy, which aimed to hand power of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] into the grasp of normal people.

==Biography==
As the head of the [[Star Cabal]], the Prince wielded massive power through his subordinates and the other members within the Cabal. When the security of the Cabal was breached, he stood in the line of [[Fire/Legends|fire]] as a lone agent attempted to dismantle the conspiracy. In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]], the Prince was present onboard the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] where he later encountered [[Cipher Nine]]. The Prince battled the Imperial agent and was killed.

==Behind the scenes==
The Prince's dialogue before his [[Death/Legends|death]] may vary depending upon Cipher Nine's dialogue before engaging the Star Cabal inner circle. If the light side dialogue is chosen, the Prince remarks that the Star Cabal once had a noble vision. If the dark side or neutral dialogue is chosen, the Prince promises that the galaxy will always be enslaved by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
